What do you mean by "the bleak monotony of Skyrim"? I found Skyrim to have a wide variety of locations, tasks, people, moods, etc. It is the most non-monotonous game I have played to this day.

The world is rich with strange dungeons, monsters, caves, towns, mountains, traders, plants to collect, cults, etc. It has complex opportunities for crafting weapons and armor. It has complex spells and potions.

Ignore the story you are meant to follow. Explore the amazing, complex world.
